entries.title: Qualcomm Incorporated, San Diego, California
entries.subtitle: Engineer, June 2022 – December 2023, Engineering Intern, May 2021 – August 2021
bullets: Enhanced device performance and stability by designing, implementing and validating Linux kernel IPC driver features in C for Android BSP, supporting HW/SW interfaces using RPMsg, Qualcomm IPC Router and Glink over SMEM.
Reproduced complex system failures and isolated root causes using JTAG/TRACE32 and kernel instrumentation, driving fixes through validation with cross-functional teams.

Optimized debugging pipelines by developing a boot-time tracing tool in C++ using ftrace tracepoints, improving fault isolation during device initialization and reducing time spent diagnosing root cause.
Enabled recovery from crashed remote processors via patches merged into the mainline Linux kernel (v6.11), implementing a hardware-lock API and Qualcomm driver support (lore.kernel.org).
Implemented and profiled lightweight TCP/IP (lwIP) stack in C, evaluating throughput and latency tradeoffs to assess feasibility as an IPC transport channel.
